defects.description: The uncovered share is given as 'nearly one in five — around 40%', but one in five is 20%, not 40% (and 80% coverage leaves 20% uncovered).
paraphrases: One in five is 20%, so 'around 40%' is wrong.
If 80% are covered, 20% are not — one in five, not 40%.
The fraction (one in five) and the percentage (40%) disagree.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'around 20%' (one in five; complement of 80%). Findable from the fraction and the 80% figure, distinct.

defects.description: 154 million deaths prevented over fifty years is called 'an average of roughly 8 million lives saved every year', but 154 / 50 is about 3 million per year.
paraphrases: 154 million over 50 years is about 3 million a year, not 8 million.
The annual average is miscalculated from the 154-million-over-fifty-years total.
Dividing 154 million by 50 gives roughly 3 million, not 8 million, per year.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'roughly 3 million' (154/50). Findable from the total and the period in the same sentence, distinct.

defects.description: The daily figure 'more than 80,000 every single day' is inconsistent with 154 million over fifty years, which is about 8,000 per day.
paraphrases: 154 million over 50 years is roughly 8,000 a day, not 80,000.
The per-day figure is about ten times too high given the stated total and period.
defects.rationale: Correct value 'more than 8,000' (154M / (50*365)). Findable from the total and the period, distinct from the per-year defect.
